name: WSFx Global Pay Limited
about: WSFx Global Pay Limited engages in the foreign exchange business (forex) in India. The company offers single and multi-currency forex prepaid cards, Thomas Cook travel cards, foreign currency notes, currency exchange, education loan, travel insurance, sending money aboard, university fees payments, and other outward remittances, as well as international student identity cards, guaranteed investment certificates, and blocked accounts. It also provides various digital platforms, including GlobalPay app and web portal for digital onboarding, online A2 form, V-CIP, and order tracking; Smart Corporate, a digital forex management tool for enterprise travel requirements; Smart Agent for the management of customer forex, remittance needs, which includes lead management; and Forex Platform as a Service (FPaaS), a plug and play solution that offers forex and remittance solutions online. The company serves students, leisure travellers, corporates, and partners. The company was formerly known as Wall Street Finance Limited and changed its name to WSFx Global Pay Limited in December 2022. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. WSFx Global Pay Limited is a subsidiary of Spice Connect Private Limited.
